notes.title: New English version !
notes.content: Now we have completed the English translation of the two villages and towns facing east and west of the university city, as well as the English translation of a shelter in the north and a mysterious area. Players are welcome to take risks and submit bugs in a timely manner. After leaving the shelter in the north, the content was not translated into English, which is the next step of work. Thank you again, My friends.

notes.title: The English version is coming soon
notes.content: The English version is about to be launched. Now we have incorporated some English cultural elements such as props and skills, and will continue to create the plot English cultural elements.

notes.title: Modified the operation sound effects and some music, as well as some bugs!
notes.content: Added familiar excerpts from old songs as background music, and also modified the original sound effects of the much-maligned RPG maker, completely replaced.

notes.title: Updated on August 7th, adding Q key for quick storage!
notes.content:
Added the quick storage key Q, which allows you to quickly open the save interface by pressing the Q key on the keyboard. (Although it cannot be automatically saved, due to a conflict between the script and the save interface, this compromise method was adopted.)

In addition, prompts have been added on the window to help beginners understand how to zoom the window.

Fixed some minor issues.
